support_scope: Calculator-core boundary for contract-backed parameter/input/output models, deterministic reference-bundle resolution, provenance-aware fixtures, and adapter separation across Python library and CLI paths. The archived scope covers the implemented Python contract/reference-data boundary and regression evidence, not every future runtime surface.
